tokens.why: one saturated blue for every primary action
near-black body text, 15:1 on white
plain white surfaces, colour comes from content
soft corners on buttons and inputs read as friendly on small screens
cards a step rounder than the controls inside them
gap between a label and its field
gap between stacked form fields and between cards
padding inside cards and dialogs
16px body text, never smaller on mobile
a tighter cut of the body face for headings
one light shadow lifts a card off the page
visible keyboard focus on every control
Orchard's brand book makes forest green the only action colour
Orchard's brand book uses square corners on every surface
square corners on cards too, same brand rule
Orchard's serif headline face, licensed for web
flat surfaces only; see the drop-shadow ban
Pell & Finch's burnt orange, matched to their shop signage
dense product grids: four cards across on a laptop
their catalogue face; 15px tested fine at their density
